notes: Outfits for the app (OutfitEngine). Every piece declares what can be customized on it; nothing else can change.
A mode picks which body slots are in use: ready (one full outfit), pieces (top, over the top, bottom), dress.
en text uses {prop} for the piece's own properties and may use {{catalogVar}} (e.g. {{accentColor}}).
props: a slot's props apply to all its pieces; a piece adds or overrides them, and "name": null removes one. A prop can set default, allow (the only options offered) or fixed (shown, not editable).
A default of "@var" follows a catalog variable ("@accentColor": the accent color of the ribbons and details).
legs: the piece shows the legs, so the Meias slot is offered. covers: slots this piece already takes care of (a ready outfit with shoes covers feet).
theme: the piece is offered only while that Estilo is picked.
Text inside pieces has no commas when it goes into a list (pieces, dress, legs, feet); full outfits may have commas.
Outfits are intended to feel cozy and non-sensual, including relaxed homewear.
relaxed: an at-home piece (a little midriff, a tank top, thin straps); while one is worn, {{outfitModesty}} is modesty.relaxed instead of modesty.default.
In pieces mode, optional undergarments are described as layers under the selected clothing.

modesty.default: Modest, non-revealing clothing: no cleavage, no bare shoulders, no emphasis on the body.
modesty.relaxed: Relaxed, comfortable homewear in soft opaque fabric: cozy and not sensual, no cleavage, no emphasis on the body.
